sources.author: Cicely Kent
sources.edition: PG6964 illustrated HTML digital witness,posted2013-03-21;not a verified printed-page transcription
sources.locator: ChII Practice and Method;ChIII General Theories;ChVII Nelros;Dictionary A:Aircraft,Acorn,Anchor,Apron;Example Cups FigureVIII principal symbols/interpretation
sources.finding: Inspected original passages. Cup handle represents consultant/home/current abode;rim is soon,under-handle present/immediate,sides later,bottom distant. Saucer centre represents consultant,successive rings home/near events,later events,then remote future. ChIII qualifies symbol size/clarity,adjacency,letters/numbers and direction;handle is south for journey direction. Time claims are qualified by intuition,not precise calendar guarantees. Aircraft changes with heading/motion;Apron with proximity;Acorn with multiplicity. FigureVIII locates organ/acorn/beetle at the lower circle and tea cosy centrally,with a conditional musician account. Nelros is a separate marked-cup method;its saucer is discouraged. These are author-attributed symbolic claims,not predictions or psychological measurements.
sources.rights_note: Original short factual notes only. No complete dictionary,image,caption corpus or PG-branded republication. Original source USA-public-domain status differs from local rights and later editions/modern adaptations.

inventory_mapping_caution: All original method/ranking/variation rows preserved verbatim. Provisional modern-source suggestions do not establish Kent rules or Turkish methods. Historical timing,marked cups and modern practice stay source-specific.
source_differences: Kent ordinary cup,saucer and decorated Nelros conventions are distinct. Modern publisher headings identify possible differences requiring full chapter inspection. No universal tea-leaf symbol dictionary or shared turning/time algorithm assumed.

feasibility.first_scope: Candidate named Kent historical-symbolic manual-placement engine:bounded source-backed zones and conditional dictionary subset,explicit placement/orientation/adjacency declarations and traditional source-located reference output. Substantive rules plus cup structure,not a relabeled journal. Manual placements satisfy the initial core without physical residue simulation.
manual_inputs: Separate ordinary-cup versus saucer selection;handle/consultant reference and declared home/away context where actually relevant
Stable symbol IDs and manual positions/depth,heading,relative size/multiplicity and explicitly declared adjacency;missing conditions remain unknown
Preserve ambiguous shape choices,overlapping zone qualifications and contradictory traditional accounts rather than forcing one meaning
Optional user observations and source comparisons remain separate from direct source rules
feasibility.deterministic: Validation,zone/condition lookup,explicit symbolic composition,source locators,portable hashes and replay can run locally without LLM or new framework. Fixed numeric bands,angular axes and conflict precedence must be identified as editorial conventions and independently tested.
feasibility.seeded: Optional future seeded symbolic arrangements may reuse the independently verified kernel only after a new protocol/distribution and known-answer fixtures. Sampled icons/placements simulate neither real leaves nor future outcomes;manual mode should remain first priority.
feasibility.visuals: A placement table and optional original simple SVG cup map could clarify handle-relative positions. No source-art copying,image recognition or photo upload required;geometric glyphs are symbolic annotations,not recognized leaf shapes.
feasibility.limits: Keep physical residue,observer-selected shapes,source-attributed meanings and editorial composition separate. No valid fortune,clinical diagnosis,personality assessment or empirical future-event evidence inferred. No assigning user characteristics from historical stereotypes.
feasibility.reuse: Pure JSON/hash utilities and optional existing seed kernel only when genuinely compatible. Earlier symbolic/journal engines and their source conventions remain unchanged;no shared universal symbol meanings.
feasibility.privacy: No real cup photo,identity,health/birth context or remote service required. Optional user-authored context stays local;synthetic examples labeled.
